hero.title: Similar templates.
hero.question: Separate copies?
hero.description: Maintain shared code once. Describe the differences in a preset, then select files and apply changes when creating each project.

diagram.label: One starter generates two editions through basic.json and team.json
diagram.caption: Edit shared code once. Keep edition differences in config.

examples.title: Less repetition in your workflow
examples.description: Start with a familiar problem. Compare the source files, preset config, and generated output.

scenarios.title: Almost identical templates, maintained separately?
scenarios.before: Keep separate copies for basic and team editions. Check and fix the same code in every copy.
scenarios.after: Keep one source. Describe the file and config differences in presets and generate the edition needed.

scenarios.title: Copying the same skills into every project?
scenarios.before: Find the usual skills, copy them one by one, then remove the ones this project does not need.
scenarios.after: Keep common skills in one repository. Select them with a preset and bring them into a project together.

scenarios.title: Only need one project from a monorepo?
scenarios.before: Clone the repository, extract a directory, remove unrelated files, then fix workspace: dependencies.
scenarios.after: Choose the directory, exclusions, and dependency rules to generate a standalone project.

scenarios.title: Making the same edits after every clone?
scenarios.before: Remove sample files, rewrite the README, and change config values every time a project is created.
scenarios.after: Describe those steps in a preset and apply them during project creation.
